44601.meaning1: fact of having faith; fact of having confidence (in)

44602.meaning1: fact of being a believer; fact of being someone who has faith; state of being someone who has confidence (in)

examples.text: pasannanetto sumukho, brahā uju patāpavā, majjhe samaṇasaṅghassa, ādicco'va virocasi.

44606.meaning1: with a faithful mind; with a devoted heart
44606.meaning2: with a happy mind; with a devoted mind
44606.commentary: (DNt) pasīdīyate pasannā, tādisā mati paññā, cittaṃ vā yassā'ti pasannamati, aññapadaliṅgappadhānattā imassa samāsapadassa pasannamatino'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: iti me pasannamatino, ratanattayavandanāmayaṃ puññaṃ, yaṃ suvihatantarāyo, hutvā tass'ānubhāvena.

44607.meaning2: having a gladdened or devoted mind

examples.text: buddhe ca dhamme ca pasannamānasā, saṅghe ca ek'antagatā asaṃsayā, akhaṇḍasikkhāpadā āgatapphalā, sambodhidhamme niyatā anāmayā'ti.

44608.meaning1: with a bright face; with a clear complexion
44608.commentary: (VINa) pasannamukhavaṇṇā'ti kiñ'c'āpi avisesena vaṇṇavanto sarīravaṇṇato pana nesaṃ mukhavaṇṇo adhikataraṃ pasanno, accho anāvilo parisuddho'ti attho.

44609.meaning1: show of confidence; display of faith
44609.commentary: (SNa) pasann'ākāraṃ karontī'ti pasannehi kattabbākāraṃ karonti, cattāro paccaye denti.

examples.text: tesaṃ gihī pasann'ākāraṃ karonti. te taṃ lābhaṃ agadhitā amucchitā anajjhopannā ādīnavadassāvino nissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti.

44610.meaning1: with clear water; with pure water

examples.text: pasayha māraṃ abhibhuyya antakaṃ, yo ca phusī jātikkhayaṃ padhānavā, so tādiso lokavidū sumedho, sabbesu dhammesu atam'mayo munī'ti.
tassa evam'assa, ayaṃ kho gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo, so ca ārakkhasampanno, n'āyaṃ sukaro pasayha jīvitā voropetuṃ. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ anupakhajja jīvitā voropeyyan'ti
eko'va indo asure jināti, eko'va seno hanti dije pasayha, eko'va byaggho migasaṅghapatto, varaṃ varaṃ hanti balañ'hi tādisaṃ.
rājā pasayhā pathaviṃ vijitvā, sasāgar'antaṃ mahim'āvasanto, oraṃ samuddassa atittarūpo, pāraṃ samuddassa'pi patthayetha.
ussūraseyyā paradārasevanā, verappasavo ca anatthatā ca, pāpā ca mittā sukadariyatā ca, ete cha ṭhānā purisaṃ dhaṃsayanti.
yaṃ kiñci pasaveyya, asuci'y'eva pasaveyya, duggandhaṃ'y'eva pasaveyya, jegucchiyaṃ'y'eva pasaveyya.

44618.meaning1: produces; generates; makes; gives birth to
44618.meaning2: brings forth, gives birth to, accumulates
44618.synonym: uppādayati, uppādeti, janeti, nipphādeti, pātukaroti, savati

examples.text: jayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, dukkhaṃ seti parājito, upasanto sukhaṃ seti, hitvā jayaparājayaṃ.
dvīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ'ca puññaṃ pasavati.

44619.meaning2: bringing forth, giving birth to, flowing, accumulating

44620.meaning2: brought forth, gave birth to, flowed, accumulated

examples.text: apuññaṃ pasavī māro, āsajja naṃ tathāgataṃ, kin'nu maññasi pāpima, na me pāpaṃ vipaccati.

44621.meaning2: brought forth, given birth to, flowed, accumulated

44622.meaning2: having brought forth, having given birth to, having flowed, having accumulated

44623.grammar: masc, nom & acc pl of pasu

examples.text: na tassa puttā pasavo, khettaṃ vatthuñ'ca vijjati, attā vā'pi nirattā vā, na tasmiṃ upalabbhati.
subh'ānupassiṃ viharantaṃ, indriyesu asaṃvutaṃ, bhojanamhi c'āmattaññuṃ, kusītaṃ hīnavīriyaṃ, taṃ ve pasahati māro, vāto rukkhaṃ'va dubbalaṃ.

44628.meaning2: having used force, having subdued, having oppressed

44629.grammar: masc, agent, in comps, from pasaṃsati

examples.text: ye pana, bhikkhu, tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ pathavīpasaṃsakā pathav'ābhinandino, āpapasaṃsakā āp'ābhinandino, tejapasaṃsakā tej'ābhinandino, vāyapasaṃsakā vāy'ābhinandino

44630.meaning1: desiring praise; wanting approval; seeking acclaim
44630.commentary: (NIDD1) pasaṃsakāmā'ti pasaṃsakāmā pasaṃs'atthikā pasaṃs'ādhippāyā pasaṃsapurekkhārā pasaṃsapariyesanaṃ carantā. (SNPa) pasaṃsakāmā kusalā vadānā'ti pasaṃs'atthikā ubho'pi mayaṃ kusalavādā paṇḍitavādā'ti evaṃsaññino hutvā.

examples.text: te vādakāmā parisaṃ vigayha, bālaṃ dahantī mithu aññam'aññaṃ, vadanti te aññasitā kath'ojjaṃ, pasaṃsakāmā kusalā vadānā.
appamādaṃ pasaṃsanti, puññakiriyāsu paṇḍitā, appamatto ubho atthe, adhiggaṇhāti paṇḍito.
saddhammapūjā'pi nesaṃ tath'eva, yathā pasaṃsanti sak'āyanāni, sabb'eva vādā tathiyā bhaveyyuṃ, suddhī hi nesaṃ paccattam'eva.
āmisaṃ'va macchānaṃ vadhāya khittā'ti yathā macchānaṃ vadh'atthāya baḷisalaggaṃ āmisaṃ khipati, evaṃ tayā pasaṃsamānena ete rūpā sattānaṃ vadhāya khittā'ti vadati.
dummedhehi pasaṃsā ca, viññūhi garahā ca yā, garahāva seyyo viññūhi, yaṃ ce bālappasaṃsanā.
ye kec'ime diṭṭhiparibbasānā, idam'eva saccan'ti vivādayanti, sabb'eva te nindam'anvānayanti, atho pasaṃsam'pi labhanti tattha.
gārayhaṃ kira, bho ānanda, so bhavaṃ gotamo jhānaṃ garahi, pāsaṃsaṃ pasaṃsi.
yassa mūlaṃ chamā n'atthi, paṇṇā n'atthi kuto latā, taṃ dhīraṃ bandhanā muttaṃ, ko taṃ ninditum'arahati. devā'pi naṃ pasaṃsanti, brahmunā'pi pasaṃsito'ti.
na c'āhu na ca bhavissati, na c'eta'r'ahi vijjati, ek'antaṃ nindito poso, ek'antaṃ vā pasaṃsito.

44639.meaning2: should be praised, should be commended

44642.meaning2: should be praised, should be commended

examples.text: yo nindiyaṃ pasaṃsati, taṃ vā nindati yo pasaṃsiyo vicināti mukhena so kaliṃ, kalinā tena sukhaṃ na vindati.
taṃ ce hi n'āddakkhuṃ tathāvimuttaṃ, (icc'āyasmā mogharājā) devā manussā idha vā huraṃ vā, nar'uttamaṃ atthacaraṃ narānaṃ, ye taṃ namassanti pasaṃsiyā te'ti.
disā hi me khantivādānaṃ, avirodhappasaṃsīnaṃ, suṇantu dhammaṃ kālena, tañ'ca anuvidhīyantu.

44644.meaning2: body where it branches from the trunk

44646.meaning1: rule about (wounds) on the lower body

44647.commentary: (MNa) satthari pasādo'ti iti'pi so bhagavā'ti-ādinā nayena buddhaguṇe anussarantānaṃ uppannappasādo. dhamme pasādo'ti svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo'ti-ādinā nayena dhammaguṇe anussarantānaṃ uppannappasādo.

examples.text: anavaṭṭhitacittassa, saddhammaṃ avijānato, pariplavapasādassa, paññā na paripūrati.
ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā appasādanīye ṭhāne pasādaṃ upadaṃseti ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā pasādanīye ṭhāne appasādaṃ upadaṃseti
idha pan'āvuso, ekacco puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti aparisuddhavacīsamācāro, labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ. evarūpe'pi, āvuso, puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo.

44650.meaning2: making bright or clear, pleasing, making happy

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kulappasādakānaṃ yadidaṃ kāḷ'udāyī.

puthulato pana diyaḍḍharatanaṃ dvīsu passesu ratanamatt'ānucaṅkamaṃ dīghato saṭṭhihatthaṃ mudutalaṃ sama-vippakiṇṇa-vālukaṃ caṅkamaṃ vaṭṭati cetiyagirimhi dīpappasādakamahindattherassa caṅkamanaṃ viya, tādisaṃ taṃ ahosi.
saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantī'ti idhā'pi purimanayen'eva attho veditabbo. yathā hi pubbe vippaṭisārakaraṃ ārammaṇaṃ dasseti, evam'idhā'pi pasādakaraṃ.

44653.meaningLit: section on things which inspires confidence

44655.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of pasādajananattha
44655.meaning1: for the purpose of arousing faith; to generate confidence
44655.construction:
pasāda + janana + attha + aṃ
pasādajananattha + aṃ

44656.meaning1: for the sake of faith; for the purpose of clear confidence

examples.text: aññāt'atthaṃ pasād'atthaṃ, sataṃ ve hoti mantanā, evaṃ kho ariyā mantenti, esā ariyāna mantanā, etadaññāya medhāvī, na samusseyya mantaye'ti.

44657.meaning1: inspiring confidence; pleasing oneself; making happy

examples.text: dadāti ve yathāsaddhaṃ, yathāpasādanaṃ jano, tattha yo maṅku bhavati, paresaṃ pānabhojane, na so divā vā rattiṃ vā, samādhim'adhigacchati.

44659.meaningLit: to cause to be settled forward

examples.text: ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā appasādanīye ṭhāne pasādaṃ upadaṃseti ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā pasādanīye ṭhāne appasādaṃ upadaṃseti
ten'ānanda, bhikkhunā kismiñci'd'eva pasādanīye nimitte cittaṃ paṇidahitabbaṃ.

44660.commentary: (VINt) pasādabhaññan'ti kevalaṃ pasādamattena bhaṇanaṃ, na pana sabhāvato ete arahanto'y'evā'ti cintetvā.

44661.meaning1: measure of confidence; degree of clarity

examples.text: etth'āhaṃ, bho gotama, aññāṇam'āpādiṃ, ettha sammoham'āpādiṃ. yā'pi me esā bhoto gotamassa purimena kathāsallāpena ahu pasādamattā sā'pi me eta'r'ahi antarahitā'ti. alañ'hi te, vaccha, aññāṇāya, alaṃ sammohāya.

44662.commentary: (ANt) dadaṃ cittaṃ pasādaye'ti dadanto deyyadhammaṃ dakkhiṇeyyahatthe patiṭṭhāpento asārato dhanato sārādānaṃ karomī'ti attano cittaṃ pasādeyya.

44666.commentary: (MNa) pasādito bhagavā'ti thero kira tattha nisinno'va dibbacakkhunā brahmānaṃ āgataṃ addasa, dibbāya sotadhātuyā ca āyācanasaddaṃ suṇi, cetopariyañāṇena bhagavato pasannabhāvaṃ aññāsi. tasmā, kañci bhikkhuṃ pesetvā pakkosiyamānānaṃ gamanaṃ nāma na phāsukaṃ, yāva satthā na peseti, tāva'd'eva gamissāmā'ti maññamāno evam'āha.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhikkhū āmantesi, uṭṭheth'āvuso, gaṇhatha pattacīvaraṃ. pasādito bhagavā cātumeyyakehi ca sakyehi brahmunā ca sahampatinā bīj'ūpamena ca taruṇ'ūpamena cā'ti.

44667.meaning2: should be gladdened, should be purified, should be made faithful, should be converted
44667.meaningLit: to cause to be settled forward

examples.text: kiñ'c'ānanda, atthavasaṃ paṭicca tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho thūp'āraho? ayaṃ tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa thūpo'ti, ānanda, bahujanā cittaṃ pasādenti.

44669.meaning1: makes (the mind) have faith (in); lets (the mind) trust (in)

examples.text: dutiyam'pi kho bhagavā kokālikaṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca, mā h'evaṃ, kokālika, avaca, mā h'evaṃ, kokālika, avaca. pasādehi, kokālika, sāriputtamoggallānesu cittaṃ. pesalā sāriputtamoggallānā'ti.

44670.meaning1: to appease; to propitiate; to reconcile
44670.meaning2: to inspire confidence; to make gain faith

examples.text: bhagavatā kho, āvuso, bhikkhusaṅgho paṇāmito'ti. tena'h'āyasmanto muhuttaṃ nisīdatha, app'eva nāma mayaṃ sakkuṇeyyāma bhagavantaṃ pasādetun'ti. evam'āvuso'ti kho te bhikkhū cātumeyyakānaṃ sakyānaṃ paccassosuṃ.

44671.meaning1: having become confident; having gained faith; having inclined (one's mind)
44671.meaning2: having gladdened, having purified, having made faithful, having converted

examples.text: ayaṃ tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa thūpoti, ānanda, bahujanā cittaṃ pasādenti. te tattha cittaṃ pasādetvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
ayaṃ māṇavo mayi cittaṃ pasādetvā kālaṃ katvā tāvatiṃsadevaloke tiṃsayojanike kanakavimāne nibbattissati.

andhabālapitaraṃ nissāya evarūpaṃ buddhaṃ upasaṅkamitvā kāyaveyyāvaṭikaṃ vā kātuṃ dānaṃ vā dātuṃ dhammaṃ vā sotuṃ n'ālatthaṃ, idāni me hatthā'pi anadhipateyyā, aññaṃ kattabbaṃ n'atthī'ti manam'eva pasādesi.
ye kho pana, bhikkhave, sunettassa satthuno brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṃ desentassa cittāni pasādesuṃ te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjiṃsu.
tañ'hi pasādhanaṃ pasādhetuṃ anucchavikā itthiyo nāma dullabhā.

44679.meaning2: having adorned, having decorated, having arrayed

examples.text: hatthesu, bhikkhave, sati ādānanikkhepanaṃ paññāyati. pādesu sati abhikkamapaṭikkamo paññāyati. pabbesu sati samiñjanapasāraṇaṃ paññāyati. kucchismiṃ sati jighacchāpipāsā paññāyati.

44682.commentary: (ANa) yatam'enaṃ pasāraye'ti yaṃ aṅgapaccaṅgaṃ pasāreyya, taṃ yataṃ saṃyatam'eva katvā pasāreyya.

examples.text: yataṃ care yataṃ tiṭṭhe, yataṃ acche yataṃ saye, yataṃ samiñjaye bhikkhu, yatam'enaṃ pasāraye.
puriso aṅkusam'ādāya, dehi pādan'ti yācati, nāgo pasārayī pādaṃ, puriso nāgam'āruhi.
so abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, samiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī ahosiṃ
seyyathā'pi, ānanda, balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya.
seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam'evaṃ kho, gijjhakūṭe pabbate antarahito sītavane āyasmato soṇassa sammukhe pāturahosi.
atha kho, bhikkhave, brahmā sahampati, seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya, evam'eva, brahmaloke antarahito mama purato pāturahosi.

44686.meaning1: should be stretched out; should be straightened; could be extended
44686.meaningLit: to cause to be gone forward

examples.text: evaṃ te abhikkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ te paṭikkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ te āloketabbaṃ, evaṃ te viloketabbaṃ, evaṃ te samiñjitabbaṃ, evaṃ te pasāritabbaṃ, evaṃ te saṅghāṭipattacīvaraṃ dhāretabban'ti.

44687.meaning2: should be stretched out; should be straightened; should be extended
44687.meaningLit: to cause to be gone forward

44688.meaning2: stretches out, spreads, holds out, offers for sale

examples.text: puṇḍarīkaṃ yathā vaggu, toye na upalimpati, evaṃ puññe ca pāpe ca, ubhaye tvaṃ na limpasi, pāde vīra pasārehi, sabhiyo vandati satthuno'ti.
balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya

44689.meaning1: having stretched out; having straightened; having extended

examples.text: so pana dhamm'āsanato otaranto dhammakathiko viya, nisseṇito otaranto puriso viya, ca dve ca hatthe dve ca pāde pasāretvā

44690.meaning2: having held out, having offered for sale

44692.meaning1: could stretch out; could straighten; could extend

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam'evaṃ kho, gijjhakūṭe pabbate antarahito sītavane āyasmato soṇassa sammukhe pāturahosi.

44693.commentary: (THIa) aṭṭhamiyā pāde pasāresiṃ, tamokhandhaṃ padāliyā'ti anavasesaṃ mohakkhandhaṃ aggamaggena padāletvā aṭṭhame divase pallaṅkaṃ bhindantī pāde pasāresiṃ. idam'eva c'assā aññābyākaraṇaṃ ahosi.

examples.text: tassā dhammaṃ suṇitvāna, yathā maṃ anusāsi sā, satt'āhaṃ ekapallaṅkena, nisīdiṃ pītisukhasamappitā, aṭṭhamiyā pāde pasāresiṃ, tamokhandhaṃ padāliyā'ti.

44694.commentary: (SNa) paññā c'enaṃ pasāsatī'ti paññā etaṃ purisaṃ, idaṃ karohi, idaṃ m'ākarī'ti anusāsati.

examples.text: saddhā dutiyā purisassa hoti, paññā c'enaṃ pasāsati, nibbān'ābhirato macco, sabbadukkhā pamuccatī'ti.

44695.commentary: (DNa) virūḷho taṃ pasāsatī'ti taṃ disaṃ virūḷho anusāsati.

examples.text: dakkhiṇañ'ca disaṃ rājā, virūḷho taṃ pasāsati, kumbhaṇḍānaṃ adhipati, mahārājā yasassiso.
so samaten'eva sudaṃ janapadaṃ pasāsati. tassa samatena janapadaṃ pasāsato pubben'āparaṃ janapadā na pabbanti, yathā taṃ pubbakānaṃ rājūnaṃ ariye cakkavattivatte vattamānānaṃ.
mahāsatto pana āgacchanto kahāpaṇasahassena saddhiṃ ekasāṭakayugaṃ tambūlapasibbake ṭhapetvā āgato.
tena hi tvaṃ mahante mahante sāṇipasibbake kārāpetvā hiraññasuvaṇṇassa pūrāpetvā sakaṭehi nibbāhāpetvā majjhe gaṅgāya sote osādehi.
